시편-61-1.title: 시편 61장 1절 역사문법적 주해
시편-61-1.exegesis: 11-12. Hence he closes with a prayer for success, and an assurance of a hearing.
시편-61-1.theologicalNote: 11-12. Hence he closes with a prayer for success, and an assurance of a hearing.

시편-61-2.title: 시편 61장 2절 역사문법적 주해
시편-61-2.exegesis: PSALM 61 Psa 61:1-8 . Neginah--or, Neginoth (see on Psa 4:1 , title). Separated from his usual spiritual privileges, perhaps by Absalom's rebellion, the Psalmist prays for divine aid, and, in view of past mercies, with great confidence of being heard. 1-3. From the end-- that is, places remote from the sanctuary ( De 28:64 ).

시편-61-5.title: 시편 61장 5절 역사문법적 주해
시편-61-5.exegesis: 4. I will abide-- So I desire to do (compare Psa 23:6 ). trust in the covert, &c.-- make my refuge, in the shadow (compare Psa 17:8 ; 36:7 ).
시편-61-5.theologicalNote: 4. I will abide-- So I desire to do (compare Psa 23:6 ). trust in the covert, &c.-- make my refuge, in the shadow (compare Psa 17:8 ; 36:7 ).

시편-61-6.title: 시편 61장 6절 역사문법적 주해
시편-61-6.exegesis: 5. the heritage-- or, part in the spiritual blessings of Israel ( Psa 21:2-4 ). vows-- implies prayers.
시편-61-6.theologicalNote: 5. the heritage-- or, part in the spiritual blessings of Israel ( Psa 21:2-4 ). vows-- implies prayers.

시편-61-7.title: 시편 61장 7절 역사문법적 주해
시편-61-7.exegesis: 6-7. the king-- himself and his royal line ending in Christ. Mercy and truth personified, as in Psa 40:11 ; 57:3 .
시편-61-7.theologicalNote: 6-7. the king-- himself and his royal line ending in Christ. Mercy and truth personified, as in Psa 40:11 ; 57:3 .
